| `payments-api` | `registry.example.invalid/payments-api:2.4.1` | 0 | 2 |
| `payments-worker` | `registry.example.invalid/payments-worker:1.9.0` | 1 | 3 |

### Notes
- Both images qualify under your "high or critical" threshold.
- `payments-worker:1.9.0` is the higher-severity of the two, carrying the only critical finding in the namespace plus 3 high findings.
- `payments-api:2.4.1` has no critical findings but 2 high findings, so it still falls inside the requested severity band.
